# ApprovalCard

Human in the loop: an agent proposes an action and waits.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ApprovalCard` · AI patterns

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ApprovalCard title={…}>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ApprovalCard>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ApprovalCard" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Human in the loop: an agent proposes an action and waits for a person to approve, edit or reject it.

## Props (ApprovalCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agent` | `React.ReactNode` | Who is asking. @default "Agent" |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` | What will happen, as an action ("Move 4 design reviews to Thursday"). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | One sentence of consequence. |
| `details` | `Array<{ label: React.ReactNode; value: React.ReactNode }>` | Label and value rows: what is affected, when, why. |
| `risk` | `'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high'` | @default "low" |
| `reversible` | `boolean` | true: "You can undo this". false: "This cannot be undone". Omit to say nothing. |
| `status` | `'pending' \| 'approved' \| 'rejected'` | @default "pending" |
| `onApprove` | `() => void` |  |
| `onEdit` | `() => void` | Shows the Edit button when set. |
| `onReject` | `() => void` |  |
| `approveLabel` | `React.ReactNode` | @default "Approve" |
| `editLabel` | `React.ReactNode` | @default "Edit" |
| `rejectLabel` | `React.ReactNode` | @default "Don't do it" |
| `decidedBy` | `React.ReactNode` | Shown after a decision ("Approved, by Aleem"). |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title'>._
